column1: # PO-07 K3 (25 Nov 2026): every system file the kit installs outside its own directory — the reconciliation list.
# Checked at the start of every stage (lib.sh installed_files_gate) and by tools/reconcile.sh. A file equal to its kit
# source is UNCHANGED; equal to units/history/<key>@<kit> it is OUTDATED; anything else is MODIFIED. flags "proposed":
# added to the kit after its stage ran on the VPS; it is installed only by an owner-authorized reconcile, and its
# absence never blocks a stage. Generated files (env files, credentials) and the application tree are not listed.
